settings.models_ready: Models read from the current Codex runtime (automatically refreshed by the runtime). Reasoning options follow the model; saving validates again.
settings.models_stale: The model catalog is stale or its freshness cannot be verified. Saving is blocked. Check network, account and runtime version, then retry. Existing settings are unchanged.
settings.models_loading: Detecting available SDK models and reasoning options…
settings.models_error: SDK model catalog unavailable. Check login, connectivity and Codex account execution mode, then retry. Existing settings are unchanged.
settings.title: Scheduling, Workflows, and Templates
settings.codex_description: Writing, figures, journal preparation, and Smart Submission run through the local Codex SDK. This is the workbench's SDK authorization, separate from your product membership and Codex Desktop sign-in.
settings.codex_runtime: The EXE's deterministic workflow engine schedules tasks. Each paper keeps a fixed SDK session; Steps, concurrency, retries, and stage handoffs do not require extra AI scheduler sessions.
settings.codex_device_note: Each device requires one official browser authorization. A paper workspace does not replace device sign-in. On a new computer, install and sign in to the product account, then connect the ChatGPT account here.
settings.codex_checking: Verifying the local Codex SDK account…
settings.codex_connecting: Opening the official ChatGPT authorization page…
settings.codex_disconnecting: Disconnecting the local Codex SDK account…
settings.codex_browser_failed: The official ChatGPT authorization page could not be opened.
settings.codex_login_opened: The official sign-in page is open. If it reports Operation timed out, cancel this attempt and reconnect, or try device code sign-in. This attempt ends after 5 minutes.
settings.codex_login_success: The Codex SDK account is connected.
settings.codex_login_failed: Authorization was not completed. Reconnect or try device code sign-in. If the official page still times out, check your browser session and network connection.
settings.codex_logout_success: The local Codex SDK account was disconnected.
settings.codex_action_failed: The Codex SDK account action did not complete. Try again.
settings.commercial_title: Product Account, Device License, and Signed Updates
settings.commercial_description: Commercial mode is off by default and does not contact a server or change existing workflows. When enabled, new starts require signed subscription entitlements; running work is never force-terminated.
settings.commercial_customer_description: The customer edition locks its service endpoint, licensing policy, and update channel into the signed release. Manuscripts and experimental data remain in your local workspace.
settings.commercial_url: Control-plane URL (HTTPS is required in production)
settings.commercial_key_path: Ed25519 public-key path for the local mock server
settings.commercial_privacy_note: Diagnostics contain only version, error code, operation category, duration, and an anonymous installation ID. Manuscripts, titles, authors, e-mail, paths, prompts, passwords, cookies, and tokens are never included.
settings.commercial_saving: Saving account, license, and update settings…
settings.commercial_activating: Signing in and activating this device…
settings.commercial_code_ready: The local development code was filled in automatically.
settings.commercial_code_sent: The code was sent. Check your inbox.
settings.commercial_signing_out: Signing out of the product account…
settings.commercial_open_url_failed: The product page could not be opened.
settings.gate_description: Strict mode waits for confirmation after Step 5. Auto-trust treats the data as manually verified and continues directly to Step 6. Changing this policy requires a password.
settings.monitor_description: Set the local time for the daily submission-status check, or check every paper immediately.
settings.smart_description: These policies apply to future starts and resumes. Saved passwords are entered into the visible browser by the trusted local broker; the SDK does not read plaintext passwords, cookies, or one-time codes.
settings.prefer_orcid: Prefer ORCID sign-in/registration, then fall back to a site account
settings.auto_authorize_orcid: Continue routine ORCID OAuth login authorization automatically
settings.require_terms: Pause at new site terms for confirmation in the visible browser
settings.auto_final_submit: Complete final submission automatically after preflight and final-page review pass
settings.auto_final_submit_note: Automatic submission still requires an immutable package, one verified target site, single-active-submission protection, and trusted receipt capture. CAPTCHA, 2FA, payment, or new legal/ethics facts still pause for the user.
settings.author_description: A template is written to each paper's author_info.md. The default is used when a paper enters the Journal & Authors stage.
settings.author_markdown_note: Edit the author_info.md Markdown structure. Fields are parsed and normalized when saved.
settings.prompt_warning: Prompt changes affect only future starts or retries. Running tasks continue with the workflow snapshot frozen at launch.
settings.prompt_backup_note: The program creates a recoverable backup and updates the prompt fingerprint before saving.
settings.saving_prompt: Saving prompt and creating a backup…
settings.codex_device_opened: Enter the one-time code below on the official page. Do not share it. If unavailable, enable device code login in your ChatGPT security settings.
settings.codex_login_timeout: Authorization timed out after 5 minutes. Close the old sign-in page, then reconnect or use a device code.
settings.codex_login_cancelled: Sign-in cancelled. You can now reconnect or use a device code.
